title_zh: 主題一：言論與法治篇《那一張沒有人刪除的照片》
title_en: Theme 1: Speech & Law - "The Photo Nobody Deleted"
subtitle_zh: 校園偷拍、私密群組外流、網路公審霸凌與民刑法連帶責任
subtitle_en: Campus Upskirting, Group Leaks, Cyberbullying & Parental Joint Liability
desc_zh: 圍繞八年級班級群組中的一張同學摔倒狼狽泥濘照，探討按讚、轉發、私訊、公開公審的法律與道德界線。
desc_en: Centers around a humiliating photo of a muddy classmate posted in a private class chat, exploring the legal and moral lines of reactions, sharing, and public doxxing.

endings.title_zh: 少年法庭的傳票與家庭風暴
endings.title_en: Juvenile Court Summons & Family Turmoil
endings.trigger_zh: 在群組中起鬨按笑臉、私自轉發至公開黑特迷因帳號（如 IG 匿名粉專）、在留言區嘲弄煽風點火，並在事發後試圖刪除對話紀錄串供。
endings.trigger_en: Encouraging harassment with laughing emojis, leaking the photo to a public meme account (e.g. IG anon page), fanning the flames in comments, and trying to delete chat logs to cover up.
endings.takeaways_zh: 觸犯《刑法第 310 條第 2 項加重誹謗罪》與《個人資料保護法》。未成年人需經少年事件處理法調查並接受保護處分；依《民法第 187 條》，父母需負連帶高額精神損害賠償。
endings.takeaways_en: Violates Taiwan Criminal Code Art. 310 (Aggravated Defamation) & Personal Data Protection Act. Minors face juvenile court protection orders; under Civil Code Art. 187, parents bear joint liability for civil damages.
endings.psychology_zh: 同儕群體認同盲從（Bandwagon Effect）、去個人化狂歡（Deindividuation）與「躲在螢幕後不用負責」的匿名僥倖心態。
endings.psychology_en: Bandwagon effect, deindividuation, and the dangerous illusion of online anonymity.
endings.question_zh: 「在群組裡只是按了笑哭貼圖、轉發了照片，為什麼在法律與道德上就成了霸凌的共謀？」
endings.question_en: "Why does simply hitting a laughing emoji or forwarding a meme legally and morally constitute complicity in cyberbullying?"

endings.title_zh: 迷因狂歡的代價・霸凌同謀的烙印
endings.title_en: Toll of Meme Carnage: The Stamp of Bullying Complicity
endings.trigger_zh: 將照片私下轉傳至好朋友死黨群當作笑話討論，推波助瀾轉發二創迷因，雖然不是最初拍照者，但在同儕網路圈擴散了傷害。
endings.trigger_en: Forwarding the photo to private circles for laughs, sharing derivative memes, and fueling rumors without being the original photographer.
endings.takeaways_zh: 網路霸凌具有「雪球效應」，每一個轉傳者都是壓垮駱駝的稻草。雖免於刑事起訴，但面臨校園霸凌防制委員會調查懲戒與長期良心自責。
endings.takeaways_en: Cyberbullying creates a snowball effect where every forward adds to the trauma. Even if avoiding criminal charges, one faces school bullying hearings and moral remorse.
endings.psychology_zh: 旁觀者責任分散效應（Diffusion of Responsibility）：「大家都傳了，又不是只有我」。
endings.psychology_en: Diffusion of responsibility: "Everyone was sharing it, why blame me alone?"
endings.question_zh: 「如果每一個轉發的人都說『我只是隨手分享』，那麼受害者所承受的痛苦該由誰負責？」
endings.question_en: "If every person who shares says 'I was just forwarding,' who is accountable for the victim's suffering?"

endings.title_zh: 旁觀者的長夜與難言的愧疚
endings.title_en: The Bystander’s Long Night: Lingering Guilt
endings.trigger_zh: 內心感到不適與同情，但害怕被班上風雲人物或小圈圈孤立排擠，選擇消極「裝作沒看到」、靜音群組、沉默已讀，未曾發聲或給予任何關心。
endings.trigger_en: Feeling discomfort and sympathy inside, but choosing passive silence, muting the group chat, and staying invisible out of fear of social isolation.
endings.takeaways_zh: 沉默並不能帶來真正的安全，反而默許了惡行的蔓延。面對同儕霸凌，私下的一句溫暖問候或非對抗性的傾聽，都是破除冷漠的重要一步。
endings.takeaways_en: Silence never creates real safety; it enables bullying to grow. Even a private warm text or non-confrontational listening can break the ice of cold indifference.
endings.psychology_zh: 旁觀者效應（Bystander Effect）、對社交排擠的恐懼與習得無助感。
endings.psychology_en: Bystander effect, terror of peer rejection, and learned helplessness.
endings.question_zh: 「面對同學被嘲笑，選擇『多一事不如少一事』的沉默，真的是中立嗎？還是另一種默許？」
endings.question_en: "When a classmate is mocked, is choosing silence really neutrality, or an unspoken consent to cruelty?"

endings.title_zh: 勇敢認錯的真誠和解
endings.title_en: The Courage to Apologize & Meaningful Reconciliation
endings.trigger_zh: 在轉傳或跟風後察覺失控，在關鍵時刻選擇主動向受害者當面鞠躬致歉，承認自己的過失，並在群組發言要求大家刪除照片。
endings.trigger_en: Realizing things got out of hand after sharing; choosing to bow and apologize in person, admitting fault, and urging peers in the group to delete the post.
endings.takeaways_zh: 修復式正義（Restorative Justice）與承擔責任的道德勇氣。真誠認錯不是軟弱，而是阻止更大法律與人際悲劇的關鍵煞車皮。
endings.takeaways_en: Restorative justice and moral courage. Sincere apologies are not weakness, but a vital brake against further legal and personal escalation.
endings.psychology_zh: 道德脫鉤（Moral Disengagement）的覺醒、同理心復甦與承擔錯誤的自我效能。
endings.psychology_en: Awakening from moral disengagement, resurgence of empathy, and self-efficacy to take responsibility.
endings.question_zh: 「在同儕都在起鬨的環境下，承認『我剛才做錯了』需要克服什麼心理障礙？」
endings.question_en: "In a crowd that cheers for mockery, what psychological barriers must one overcome to say: 'I was wrong'?"

endings.title_zh: 安靜的守護者・風暴中的避風港
endings.title_en: The Quiet Guardian: Sanctuary in the Storm
endings.trigger_zh: 不與強勢霸凌者當面激烈衝突，但立刻私下遞面紙、傳訊安慰敏萱、陪同她前往健康中心，給予受害者最即時的情緒支持與陪伴。
endings.trigger_en: Avoiding direct confrontation with dominant peers, but discreetly offering tissues, sending comforting texts, and accompanying the victim to the nurse office.
endings.takeaways_zh: 同理陪伴的力量。遭遇霸凌與羞辱時，受害者最需要的往往不是高調的正義口號，而是一個「相信她、願意留在她身邊」的真實依靠。
endings.takeaways_en: The profound power of compassionate presence. Victims in crisis often need a trusted companion who stays by their side rather than loud heroic slogans.
endings.psychology_zh: 人際微正義（Micro-affirmation）、情感連結韌性與共感同理心。
endings.psychology_en: Interpersonal micro-affirmations, emotional connection resilience, and deep empathy.
endings.question_zh: 「當你覺得自己力量微小時，有哪些『低風險但高價值』的方法可以溫柔支撐受傷的人？」
endings.question_en: "When you feel powerless, what low-risk yet deeply impactful actions can comfort a wounded soul?"

endings.title_zh: 破局的勇氣・卓越數位公民
endings.title_en: Courage to Break the Silence: Exemplary Digital Citizen
endings.trigger_zh: 在群組中果斷發聲制止、立即截圖保留違法外流證據、陪同受害者向導師與學務處通報，甚至透過 iWIN 網路內容防護機構提出申訴下架。
endings.trigger_en: Decisively speaking up in chat, preserving forensic screenshots, reporting to counselors, and submitting a takedown request to iWIN.
endings.takeaways_zh: 卓越數位公民素養：善用制度與專業資源解決衝突。懂得證據保全、向可信任體系求助，以具體行動終止霸凌惡浪。
endings.takeaways_en: High digital citizenship: leveraging institutions and official resources. Preserving evidence and taking action to break the spiral of silence.
endings.psychology_zh: 道德自主性（Moral Agency）、積極旁觀者干預（Active Bystander Intervention）。
endings.psychology_en: Moral agency, proactive bystander intervention, and civic empowerment.
endings.question_zh: 「通報老師或向專線求助，為什麼不是『打小報告』，而是對生命的關鍵守護？」
endings.question_en: "Why is seeking help from authorities not 'tattling,' but an act of life-saving protection?"

title_zh: 主題二：成癮與自律篇《被偷走的深夜光年》
title_en: Theme 2: Addiction & Self-Regulation - "The Stolen Midnight Light"
subtitle_zh: 段考前夕的排位賽、多巴胺劫持、限時課金誘惑與大腦前額葉修復
subtitle_en: Exam Eve Gaming Streaks, Dopamine Traps, In-App Microtransactions & Prefrontal Self-Control
desc_zh: 面對戰隊連敗的不甘心、短影音演算法的無限下滑與限時外觀的誘惑，如何奪回生活主導權。
desc_en: Examining the psychology of "just one more game," infinite video scrolls, microtransaction guilt, and reclaiming agency over one’s time.

endings.title_zh: 失控的代價・信任破產與考場崩潰
endings.title_en: Cost of Chaos: Shattered Trust & Exam Collapse
endings.trigger_zh: 被連敗怒火牽制，瞞著父母偷偷刷卡儲值 890 元抽卡禮包，通宵打排位到清晨五點，在段考考場上大腦當機虛脫送醫。
endings.trigger_en: Driven by tilt, secretly charging parents' card for an $890 bundle, binge-gaming until 5 AM, and fainting in the middle of the midterm exam.
endings.takeaways_zh: 短影音與抽卡機制的「變動比率增強」多巴胺陷阱；未成年擅自盜刷信用卡嚴重摧毀家庭信任；剝奪深層睡眠使前額葉自控力全面癱瘓。
endings.takeaways_en: Variable ratio reinforcement traps in gacha and reels; unauthorized microtransactions destroy family trust; severe sleep deprivation paralyzes prefrontal control.
endings.psychology_zh: 沉沒成本謬誤（Sunk Cost Fallacy）、情緒傾斜（Tilt）與逃避現實的惡性循環。
endings.psychology_en: Sunk cost fallacy, gaming tilt, and toxic escapism cycles.
endings.question_zh: 「當你告訴自己『再打一把就好』時，究竟是你想玩，還是大腦的多巴胺在控制你？」
endings.question_en: "When you say 'just one more match,' is it your free will, or a hijacked dopamine circuit speaking?"

endings.title_zh: 被同儕焦慮綁架的空虛贏家
endings.title_en: The Hollow Victor: Chained by Peer Anxiety
endings.trigger_zh: 為了維持在班級戰隊中的「大神」形象與談資，即便體力不支依然不敢下線，深怕拒絕就會被踢出小圈圈失去朋友。
endings.trigger_en: Refusing to log off despite physical exhaustion just to keep the "pro player" status in the class squad, terrified of being left out.
endings.takeaways_zh: 錯失恐懼症（FOMO）的代價。真正的健康友誼建立在互相體諒，而非建立在熬夜排位的虛擬戰績上。
endings.takeaways_en: The insidious cost of FOMO. True friendships are built on mutual respect and real-world care, not late-night ranked ladders.
endings.psychology_zh: 錯失恐懼症（FOMO）、外在認同焦慮與自我價值感低落。
endings.psychology_en: Fear of Missing Out (FOMO), external validation dependency, and vulnerable self-esteem.
endings.question_zh: 「如果一個朋友只因為你不熬夜打遊戲就排擠你，這段友誼真的值得你犧牲健康與學業去換嗎？」
endings.question_en: "If someone excludes you because you won't ruin your sleep for games, is that friendship worth the sacrifice?"

endings.title_zh: 承認脆弱的勇氣・向陽的第一步
endings.title_en: Courage in Vulnerability: The First Step Toward Sunlight
endings.trigger_zh: 意識到自己無法抗拒螢幕誘惑後，放下防備主動向父母或輔導老師坦承：「我發現自己停不下來，請幫幫我」。
endings.trigger_en: Recognizing one's inability to resist screen compulsions; opening up to parents or school counselors to request structural help.
endings.takeaways_zh: 承認失控不是軟弱，求助是成熟自律的開端。建立物理隔離（如夜間手機放客廳充電）與家庭數位契約，重建健康作息。
endings.takeaways_en: Admitting vulnerability is maturity, not weakness. Implementing physical separation (charging phones outside bedrooms) restores balance.
endings.psychology_zh: 求助效能感、接納脆弱（Vulnerability Acceptance）與元認知監控。
endings.psychology_en: Help-seeking self-efficacy, emotional openness, and metacognitive awareness.
endings.question_zh: 「向大人承認『我控制不了玩手機』為什麼需要極大的勇氣？這能為你帶來什麼改變？」
endings.question_en: "Why does admitting 'I cannot control my screen time' require great courage, and how can it change your life?"

endings.title_zh: 及時停損的成長痛・生命的煞車皮
endings.title_en: Growing Pains of Cutting Losses: The Brakes of Life
endings.trigger_zh: 雖然經歷了一夜的掙扎與考場上的疲憊挫折，但看著慘痛的成績單深刻反省，下定決心刪除遊戲或關閉短影音通知，及時煞車。
endings.trigger_en: Experiencing exam exhaustion, receiving poor grades, but taking it as a wake-up call to uninstall games and mute notifications.
endings.takeaways_zh: 挫折是成長的試金石。及時停損（Stop-loss）是人生最重要的智慧之一，允許自己犯錯，但絕不在同一個坑跌倒第二次。
endings.takeaways_en: Failure can be a catalyst for resilience. Cutting losses in time is crucial wisdom: allowing mistakes without repeating them.
endings.psychology_zh: 延遲滿足能力（Delayed Gratification）的覺醒、挫折復原力（Resilience）。
endings.psychology_en: Delayed gratification re-calibration and academic resilience.
endings.question_zh: 「段考考差了可以重來，但如果一直養成『拖延與逃避』的習慣，未來的代價會是什麼？」
endings.question_en: "Bad test scores can be improved, but what is the long-term price of letting habitual avoidance take root?"

endings.title_zh: 數位斷捨離・奪回大腦主導權
endings.title_en: Digital Detox: Reclaiming Mind & Mental Clarity
endings.trigger_zh: 果斷在睡前半小時遠離螢幕，開啟夜間專注模式，以閱讀實體書、伸展或聽白噪音替代滑手機，守護褪黑激素分泌。
endings.trigger_en: Powering down screens 30 minutes before bed, setting focus modes, and reading physical books to protect melatonin secretion.
endings.takeaways_zh: 數位健康（Digital Wellbeing）的實踐：阻隔睡前藍光、打造無干擾睡眠環境，保護大腦深度休息與記憶鞏固功能。
endings.takeaways_en: Practicing digital hygiene: shielding eyes from blue light, protecting circadian rhythms, and optimizing sleep memory consolidation.
endings.psychology_zh: 環境架構設計（Choice Architecture）、內在動機激發與情緒平穩。
endings.psychology_en: Choice architecture design, intrinsic motivation, and emotional steadiness.
endings.question_zh: 「當你放下手機睡前安靜閱讀十分鐘，你的心靈和大腦感受到了什麼不同的平靜？」
endings.question_en: "When you unplug and read quietly before sleep, what newfound tranquility do your mind and body experience?"

endings.title_zh: 從容的掌控者・卓越身心靈主宰
endings.title_en: Master of Autonomy: Balanced Life Sovereign
endings.trigger_zh: 清楚界定生活各維度優先次序，面對戰隊召喚能溫和堅定地拒絕：「明天段考，我今晚必須早點睡」，既享受娛樂又主宰學業生活。
endings.trigger_en: Clearly establishing priorities; responding calmly yet firmly to team invites: "I have midterms tomorrow, see you this weekend!"
endings.takeaways_zh: 自我決定理論（SDT）最高境界：在勝任感、自主性與歸屬感間取得健康平衡。科技是為我所用的僕人，而非主宰心靈的主人。
endings.takeaways_en: High self-determination theory: balance of competence, autonomy, and relatedness. Technology serves as a tool, not a tyrannical master.
endings.psychology_zh: 高情商堅毅力（Grit）、健康的心理邊界與強大的前額葉執行控制力。
endings.psychology_en: Emotional grit, clear assertive boundaries, and robust prefrontal executive control.
endings.question_zh: 「能在誘惑面前說『不』，並從容掌控自己節奏的人，具備了哪些受用一生的底氣？」
endings.question_en: "What lifelong inner strength does a person possess when they can assertively say 'no' to instant temptations?"

title_zh: 主題三：誘騙與隱私篇《螢幕對面的「完美朋友」》
title_en: Theme 3: Grooming & Privacy - "The Perfect Friend Across the Screen"
subtitle_zh: 網路遊戲溫柔大神、限定虛寶利誘、私密照索取、性勒索與 iWIN 防護機制
subtitle_en: Charismatic Gamers, In-Game Bribes, Nude Exploitation, Sextortion & Takedown Shields
desc_zh: 探討網路兒少性剝削與誘騙（Grooming）陷阱，學會辨識情感勒索，守住隱私防線與尋求專業救援。
desc_en: Deconstructing online grooming steps, predatory emotional manipulation, digital sextortion defenses, and utilizing legal/iWIN shields.

endings.title_zh: 深淵的無底洞・恐懼與屈服的惡果
endings.title_en: The Bottomless Abyss: Cost of Submission & Secrecy
endings.trigger_zh: 被甜言蜜語與昂貴造型蒙蔽而發送了私密照，遭對方勒索時因恐懼名譽掃地而隱瞞隱忍，甚至照對方指示拍更多照片以求刪除。
endings.trigger_en: Blinded by flattery and gifts, sending private photos, then complying with escalating demands out of panic and humiliation.
endings.takeaways_zh: 數位性勒索（Sextortion）的殘酷法則：歹徒的胃口永遠不會滿足，妥協只會淪為更深的禁錮。「不順從、不刪除、不付錢、立即求助」是唯一脫困之道。
endings.takeaways_en: The harsh rule of sextortion: predators never stop. Compliance is a downward spiral. The only escape is: Never comply, preserve evidence, seek help.
endings.psychology_zh: 恐懼癱瘓（Terror Freeze）、有毒羞恥感（Toxic Shame）與孤立無援心理。
endings.psychology_en: Terror freeze, internalized toxic shame, and weaponized isolation.
endings.question_zh: 「面對歹徒威脅『不給就外流』，為什麼任何順從都只會讓籌碼越來越多？」
endings.question_en: "When an extortionist threatens exposure, why does giving in only give them more power over you?"

endings.title_zh: 被敲詐的羔羊・散盡零用錢的自欺
endings.title_en: Prey to Extortion: Squandering Savings in Self-Deception
endings.trigger_zh: 誤以為可以用自己的零用錢或偷偷偷拿家裡的錢買遊戲點數「花錢消災」，結果對方不斷加碼索討，陷入人財兩失。
endings.trigger_en: Believing that paying off the blackmailer with gift cards will buy silence, only to face higher demands and empty pockets.
endings.takeaways_zh: 敲詐勒索罪的犯罪本質。金錢絕不可能買回被盜取的私密檔案；私下交易只會讓歹徒食髓知味。
endings.takeaways_en: The criminal nature of extortion. Money never buys back digital files; private payouts merely fuel predator greed.
endings.psychology_zh: 駝鳥心態、逃避現實與金錢消災的幻覺。
endings.psychology_en: Ostrich avoidance, magical thinking, and vulnerability to financial coercion.
endings.question_zh: 「為什麼面對犯罪分子的恐嚇，試圖『私下花錢解決』注定是一條走不通的死胡同？」
endings.question_en: "Why is trying to 'quietly buy your way out' with a criminal destined to be a dead-end street?"

endings.title_zh: 家庭的堅盾・斬斷黑手的勇氣之光
endings.title_en: The Family Shield: Severing the Predator’s Grip
endings.trigger_zh: 在受到威脅的第一時間，克服巨大的恐懼與羞恥感，坦白向父母求助。父母化作最堅強的護盾，報警由科技偵查隊介入將歹徒繩之以法。
endings.trigger_en: Overcoming profound shame at the very first threat; confessing to parents who immediately contact cyber police to apprehend the offender.
endings.takeaways_zh: 家庭是孩子最強大的避風港。犯罪分子最懼怕的就是「體制與長輩介入」；《兒童及少年性剝削防制條例》為公訴重罪，法律會全力保護受害者。
endings.takeaways_en: Family is the ultimate haven. Predators fear parental and police intervention above all; Taiwan Child & Youth Sexual Exploitation Act provides strong legal shields.
endings.psychology_zh: 打破沉默羞恥、信任依附（Secure Attachment）與家庭韌性。
endings.psychology_en: Breaking the shame barrier, secure attachment trust, and familial resilience.
endings.question_zh: 「向父母坦承自己受騙時，最害怕的是什麼？父母的理解與保護為什麼比任何自責都更有力量？」
endings.question_en: "What do teens fear most when confessing to parents, and why is parental protection stronger than any guilt?"

endings.title_zh: 專業防護網・破網而出的重生
endings.title_en: Professional Rescue: Rebirth from the Predator’s Web
endings.trigger_zh: 不敢第一時間告訴家人，但記起學校宣導，主動撥打 iWIN 網路內容防護專線（02-2577-5118），並透過國際 StopNCII 機制阻斷影像散布。
endings.trigger_en: Uncertain about approaching parents right away, but dialing iWIN helpline (02-2577-5118) and submitting digital hashes to StopNCII to block image leaks.
endings.takeaways_zh: 善用專業求助管道。iWIN 具備官方與社群平台的快速下架機制，並能提供專業心理諮商與法律轉介服務，不需獨自一人承受恐慌。
endings.takeaways_en: Leveraging institutional safety nets: iWIN coordinates fast takedowns with platforms, providing psychological counseling and legal assistance.
endings.psychology_zh: 主動求生策略（Active Coping）、善用客觀系統資源。
endings.psychology_en: Active problem-focused coping and strategic system resource navigation.
endings.question_zh: 「如果身邊有同學遇到私密照外流威脅不敢告訴家人，你可以提供他哪些具體的專業求助管道？」
endings.question_en: "If a friend faces private photo blackmail and fears telling parents, what official resources can you guide them to?"

endings.title_zh: 警鐘長鳴・幸免於難的智慧底線
endings.title_en: Close Call: The Wisdom of Drawing Firm Boundaries
endings.trigger_zh: 在對方要求開啟視訊或傳送生活隱私照片時察覺不對勁，雖然對方語氣溫柔且給予大量好處，但守住「絕不傳個人影像」的底線果斷封鎖。
endings.trigger_en: Noticing red flags when asked for video calls or personal photos; refusing bribes and firmly blocking the user before any boundary is breached.
endings.takeaways_zh: 識破線上誘騙（Grooming）四部曲：親近建立關係 ➔ 孤立現實朋友 ➔ 試探身體界線 ➔ 恐嚇控制。在界線被試探時果斷說「不」是最佳防護。
endings.takeaways_en: Recognizing grooming stages: building rapport, isolating from family, testing bodily boundaries, and coercion. Saying "no" at the testing stage stops predators cold.
endings.psychology_zh: 身體與數位界線意識（Digital Bodily Autonomy）、直覺警報機制。
endings.psychology_en: Bodily and digital boundary autonomy, healthy gut-check instincts.
endings.question_zh: 「當一個網路上的陌生人對你『異常好』甚至送你貴重禮物時，你應該用什麼角度思考他的動機？」
endings.question_en: "When an online acquaintance showers you with excessive gifts and attention, how should you evaluate their true motive?"

endings.title_zh: 明鏡之心・校園數位安全防禦使
endings.title_en: Campus Digital Defense Envoy: Clear Mirror of Truth
endings.trigger_zh: 面對利誘心如明鏡，第一時間識破對方的獵捕意圖，反向截圖對話留存證據，在班級與遊戲群組發布預警，保護更多同學免於受害。
endings.trigger_en: Instantly seeing through predatory gift traps, collecting screenshots of malicious accounts, and warning classmates and guild members to protect others.
endings.takeaways_zh: 頂尖資安與防誘騙素養。牢記「真正的朋友絕不會要求你拿隱私去證明信任」；成為校園中主動守護他人的資安小使者。
endings.takeaways_en: Elite cybersecurity and anti-grooming literacy. Remembering that true friends never demand privacy compromises to prove loyalty.
endings.psychology_zh: 反脆弱心態（Antifragile）、高情境警覺度與利他守護精神。
endings.psychology_en: Antifragile mindset, high situation awareness, and protective altruism.
endings.question_zh: 「如何向同儕傳遞『保護隱私不是見外，而是真正的自我尊重』這項核心觀念？」
endings.question_en: "How can we help peers understand that safeguarding privacy isn't being distant, but genuine self-respect?"

title_zh: 主題四：詐騙與金錢篇《免費代幣的代價》
title_en: Theme 4: Scams & Money - "The Price of Free Tokens"
subtitle_zh: 短影音好康釣魚、簡訊 OTP 驗證碼盜刷、洗錢人頭帳戶與 165 反詐機制
subtitle_en: Phishing Reels, SMS OTP Bypasses, Money Laundering Mule Accounts & 165 Hotlines
desc_zh: 剖析「免費送點數」、「內部漏洞」等網路釣魚陷阱，認識驗證碼防護、防範人頭帳戶涉法風險。
desc_en: Deconstructing free-currency lures, unauthorized carrier billing, accidental involvement in money laundering schemes, and staying cyber-smart.

endings.title_zh: 貪念的代價・連環被詐與帳號永失
endings.title_en: Toll of Greed: Cascading Scams & Permanent Loss
endings.trigger_zh: 相信短影音免費代幣連結在釣魚網站輸入帳密和 OTP，被盜號後又輕信網路上「專業黑客收費幫忙找回」，二次落入詐騙圈套。
endings.trigger_en: Entering login & OTP on phishing links for free tokens; after being hacked, paying self-proclaimed online recovery hackers, falling for a secondary scam.
endings.takeaways_zh: 簡訊 OTP 驗證碼是金錢與個資的最高防線，等同於個人印章與簽名；網路上聲稱付費找回帳號的「科技公司/黑客」百分之百為二次詐騙。
endings.takeaways_en: SMS OTPs are the ultimate gatekeeper of funds and identity, equivalent to a physical signature. Online recovery agents are 100% secondary scams.
endings.psychology_zh: 貪婪誘餌效應、沉沒成本焦慮與過度自信盲區。
endings.psychology_en: Greed lures, panic over sunk costs, and overconfidence bias.
endings.question_zh: 「為什麼簡訊發送的 6 位數 OTP 驗證碼，在任何情況下都絕對不能交給任何人？」
endings.question_en: "Why must a 6-digit SMS OTP verification code never, under any circumstances, be shared with anyone?"

endings.title_zh: 警示帳戶的陰影・淪為洗錢人頭戶
endings.title_en: Shadow of Flagged Accounts: Laundering Accomplice
endings.trigger_zh: 為了賺取「代收手續費」或挽回帳號損失，出借自己的郵局金融卡、提供密碼或協助提款轉帳，不知不覺淪為詐騙集團洗錢工具。
endings.trigger_en: Lending postal ATM cards or assisting fund transfers in exchange for "commissions," becoming an unwitting money mule for criminal syndicates.
endings.takeaways_zh: 觸犯《洗錢防制法》第 15 條之 2 與《刑法詐欺罪》共同正犯！個人名下所有銀行帳戶將被列為警示帳戶凍結，聯徵信用破產，終身留有司法紀錄。
endings.takeaways_en: Violates Anti-Money Laundering Act Art. 15-2 & fraud co-principal! All bank accounts will be blacklisted and frozen, destroying lifelong credit.
endings.psychology_zh: 無知僥倖心理、金錢利誘盲從與法律常識真空。
endings.psychology_en: Naive opportunism, susceptibility to financial bribes, and legal illiteracy.
endings.question_zh: 「只是把郵局卡片借給別人幾天賺點外快，為什麼會面臨警方移送法辦與帳戶全面凍結的嚴重後果？」
endings.question_en: "Why does simply lending your ATM card for quick cash lead to criminal indictments and frozen bank accounts?"

endings.title_zh: 破萬帳單的震盪・家庭信任的裂痕
endings.title_en: Five-Figure Bill Shock: Fractured Family Trust
endings.trigger_zh: 誤將 OTP 當成一般確認碼送出，導致電信小額付款被連續盜刷上萬元，因害怕挨罵一直瞞到下個月電信催繳帳單寄達家中才引爆。
endings.trigger_en: Sharing OTPs leading to thousands of dollars in carrier billing fraud, hiding the incident until parents receive the massive phone bill next month.
endings.takeaways_zh: 認識電信小額付款（Carrier Billing）機制；隱瞞錯誤只會讓問題惡化，主動溝通與止血是面對危機的唯一正確態度。
endings.takeaways_en: Understanding direct carrier billing risks; hiding errors compounds financial and emotional damage. Early honesty is the only way out.
endings.psychology_zh: 害怕受罰的逃避心理、僥倖鴕鳥心態。
endings.psychology_en: Punishment avoidance, defensive procrastination, and communication breakdown.
endings.question_zh: 「發生被盜刷時，及時告知父母與瞞著等帳單來，兩者的後果與信任差距有多大？」
endings.question_en: "When unauthorized charges occur, how vast is the difference in trust between confessing early vs hiding until the bill arrives?"

endings.title_zh: 痛定思痛的學費・誠實擔當的勇氣
endings.title_en: Hard-Learned Tuition: Courage to Be Honest
endings.trigger_zh: 在被扣款後第一時間沒有說謊，立刻向父母坦白整起事件，拿零用錢分期承擔，並由家長陪同致電電信客服關閉小額付款並向 165 備案。
endings.trigger_en: Confessing immediately after noticing the charge, offering personal allowance to offset loss, and having parents shut down carrier billing and file a 165 report.
endings.takeaways_zh: 金錢損失可以賺回，誠實品格無價。犯錯時不諉過、積極止血，透過承擔後果在挫折中真正學會成熟與自立。
endings.takeaways_en: Money can be restored; integrity is priceless. Taking responsibility and stopping further bleeding transforms mistakes into valuable life lessons.
endings.psychology_zh: 責任承擔、挫折復原力與親子溝通重塑。
endings.psychology_en: Accountability, resilience, and repair of parent-child communicative trust.
endings.question_zh: 「主動拿零用錢承擔自己犯錯造成的損失，對青少年的自立與金錢觀有什麼深遠影響？」
endings.question_en: "How does taking financial responsibility for one's mistakes shape a teen's long-term maturity and money ethics?"

endings.title_zh: 止步懸崖・警覺自保的智慧清醒者
endings.title_en: Stepping Back from the Brink: Vigilant Survivor
endings.trigger_zh: 在準備輸入驗證碼時，看見簡訊文字寫著「電信購買扣款 NT$2,990」，猛然警醒立刻關閉網頁、重設遊戲密碼並致電電信公司。
endings.trigger_en: Noticing the SMS text: "Direct carrier charge NT$2,990"; instantly halting, closing the tab, resetting passwords, and contacting telco.
endings.takeaways_zh: 養成仔細閱讀驗證簡訊全文（包含交易金額、服務名稱）的習慣；牢記防詐核心心法：「天底下沒有白吃的午餐，非官方的免費福利就是陷阱」。
endings.takeaways_en: Always read full SMS prompts (amounts, services) instead of just numbers. "If it is free and too good to be true, you are the product/prey."
endings.psychology_zh: 批判性閱讀力、衝動煞車機制與安全直覺。
endings.psychology_en: Critical text evaluation, impulse braking, and situational vigilance.
endings.question_zh: 「為什麼多數人在看簡訊時只看『數字驗證碼』，卻忽略了旁邊最重要的『交易扣款提醒』？」
endings.question_en: "Why do most people glance only at the 6 digits, completely ignoring the warning labels right next to them?"

endings.title_zh: 火眼金睛・校園反詐與資安卓越使
endings.title_en: Campus Anti-Fraud & Cyber Guardian: Master of Discernment
endings.trigger_zh: 一眼識破釣魚網站的偽造網址（非官方根網域），主動向 165 全民防騙網檢舉假網址，並在班級群組發布釣魚警訊，保護同學不受騙。
endings.trigger_en: Spotting domain spoofing instantly, reporting fraudulent URLs to the 165 anti-fraud bureau, and issuing an alert in class chats.
endings.takeaways_zh: 頂尖資安素養：啟用雙重驗證（2FA）、辨識官方網域名稱、熟悉 165 反詐通報機制，成為校園數位安全的堅實守門人。
endings.takeaways_en: Elite cybersecurity literacy: 2FA adoption, domain verification, utilizing 165 channels, and acting as an active campus cybersecurity mentor.
endings.psychology_zh: 系統思維、高度資安敏銳度與積極利他精神。
endings.psychology_en: Systems thinking, situational security acumen, and proactive altruism.
endings.question_zh: 「一個具備資訊安全敏銳度的學生，如何運用自己的知識在校園中建立一道守護同儕的防護牆？」
endings.question_en: "How can a cyber-literate student use their knowledge to construct an invisible safety shield around their peers?"

title_zh: 主題五：AI 與真偽篇《真假莫辨的鏡子》
subtitle_zh: Deepfake 換臉造假、聲音複製惡搞、加重誹謗罪、網路公審獵巫與事實查核
subtitle_en: Deepfakes & Voice Clones, Defamation Laws, Online Witch Hunts & Fact-Checking Literacy
desc_zh: 面對同學利用 AI 生成偽造的師長羞辱短影音與全網瘋傳公審，探討真偽辨識、法律責任與批判性思考。
desc_en: Confronting an AI-generated deepfake video defaming a teacher, exploring how algorithms amplify witch-hunts, legal liabilities, and verification tools.

endings.title_zh: 同溫層的俘虜・被演算法玩弄的盲從審判
endings.title_en: Captive of the Echo Chamber: The Witch-Hunt Mob
endings.trigger_zh: 被激動的情緒煽動，未經查證便在 Threads、TikTok 瘋狂轉發留言，痛罵導師並參與網路公審，自詡為「正義使者」，直到真相大白時名譽掃地。
endings.trigger_en: Swayed by emotional outrage, forwarding deepfake videos on Threads and TikTok without verification, joining online witch-hunts until the truth emerges.
endings.takeaways_zh: 演算法迴音室（Echo Chamber）與情緒極化效應。「打著正義旗幟的集體狂歡」往往是網路霸凌最致命的型態，對無辜者造成永久的心理傷害。
endings.takeaways_en: Algorithmic echo chambers and emotional polarization. Online witch-hunts disguised as righteous crusades cause irreversible devastation to innocent lives.
endings.psychology_zh: 群體極化（Group Polarization）、道德優越感幻覺與憤怒成癮。
endings.psychology_en: Group polarization, self-righteous moral superiority, and indignation addiction.
endings.question_zh: 「當網路上的影音讓你產生強烈的憤怒與道德衝動時，為什麼這時候正是最需要『停下來查證』的時刻？」
endings.question_en: "When online content sparks overwhelming moral rage, why is that precisely the moment you must pause and verify?"

endings.title_zh: 法網難逃・轉發 AI 造假影音的法律代價
endings.title_en: Caught in the Net: Legal Cost of Defamatory Deepfakes
endings.trigger_zh: 明知影片可能是 AI 偽造或來源可疑，依然為了蹭流量而大量轉發公開，甚至在警方調查時協助同學串供掩蓋事實。
endings.trigger_en: Knowingly spreading suspicious AI-generated videos for views and clicks, and attempting to coordinate cover-ups when police investigate.
endings.takeaways_zh: 《刑法第 310 條第 2 項加重誹謗罪》明確規範以散布影音誹謗他人；民法上受害者得請求高額精神撫慰金並要求公開道歉，父母需承擔連帶責任。
endings.takeaways_en: Criminal Code Art. 310-2 treats audiovisual defamation severely. Victims can claim substantial damages and court-ordered apologies, backed by parental joint liability.
endings.psychology_zh: 流量成癮、僥倖心態與對司法追查科技的無知。
endings.psychology_en: Social metric addiction, hubris, and ignorance of digital forensics.
endings.question_zh: 「即使影片不是你做的，轉發明知有疑點的誹謗影音，在法律上為什麼同樣構成共同侵權責任？」
endings.question_en: "Even if you didn't synthesize the video, why does amplifying defamatory deepfakes incur civil and criminal liability?"

endings.title_zh: 被出賣的誠信・二手謠言的長久陰影
endings.title_en: Compromised Integrity: The Shadow of Secondhand Rumors
endings.trigger_zh: 在私人群組大肆轉發八卦並加油添醋，當整起事件被證實為 AI 假造時，自己在同儕圈中被貼上「製造假新聞、愛造謠」的標籤，失去朋友信任。
endings.trigger_en: Spreading the fake video in friend circles with sensational gossip; when debunked, earning a permanent reputation as an unreliable rumor-monger.
endings.takeaways_zh: 人際信任是極度脆弱的資產。轉發未查證訊息會直接摧毀個人信譽；成為負責任的閱聽人是數位人際互動的基礎底線。
endings.takeaways_en: Social trust is fragile. Forwarding unverified rumors erodes personal credibility; responsible news literacy is the bedrock of digital relationships.
endings.psychology_zh: 八卦作為社交貨幣（Gossip as Social Currency）的心理誤區。
endings.psychology_en: The dangerous pitfall of treating gossip as cheap social currency.
endings.question_zh: 「為了在朋友聚會中顯得『消息靈通』而轉發八卦，為什麼最後反而會失去所有人對你的信任？」
endings.question_en: "Why does sharing unverified gossip to look 'in the loop' ultimately destroy people's trust in you?"

endings.title_zh: 勇敢自清的救贖・真誠致歉的力量
endings.title_en: Redemption Through Truth: The Power of Sincere Apology
endings.trigger_zh: 在得知影片為 AI 造假的第一時間，主動刪除轉發內容，在個人社群公開發布澄清道歉文，並當面向受冤枉的老師深深鞠躬道歉。
endings.trigger_en: Upon discovering the video is fake, immediately deleting posts, issuing public retractions, and bowing in sincere apology to the wronged teacher.
endings.takeaways_zh: 道德修復與擔當的力量。在謠言傳播鏈中，能夠及時停步並勇敢更正訊息的人，是阻止傷害繼續擴大的關鍵節點。
endings.takeaways_en: The power of moral rectification. In an algorithmic firestorm, the courage to retract, clarify, and apologize halts the chain of destruction.
endings.psychology_zh: 道德勇氣、承認過失與修復人際信任的復原力。
endings.psychology_en: Moral integrity, admitting mistakes, and restorative reconciliation resilience.
endings.question_zh: 「在公開社群上發布『我之前轉發的是假消息，我為此道歉』，為什麼比刪文裝死更值得尊敬？」
endings.question_en: "Why is posting 'I shared misinformation and I apologize' far more honorable than silently deleting and pretending nothing happened?"

endings.title_zh: 冷靜審視的慧眼・破除迷霧的清醒者
endings.title_en: Sober Observer: Piercing the Fog of Falsehood
endings.trigger_zh: 看到影片時不盲目跟風，敏銳觀察到影片中嘴形不同步、眨眼不自然、聲音帶有金屬機械音等 AI 生成破綻，堅持「不轉傳、不留言、冷靜求證」。
endings.trigger_en: Refusing to jump on the outrage bandwagon; noticing robotic lip-syncing and synthetic speech flaws; practicing "Stop, Verify, Don't Share."
endings.takeaways_zh: 媒體素養第一原則：遇到情緒激昂的爆料內容，先冷靜「停看聽」；掌握生成式 AI 在視覺與聽覺上的微小偽造破綻。
endings.takeaways_en: First principle of media literacy: pause when emotionally provoked. Master the detection of visual artifacts and robotic voice synthesis in deepfakes.
endings.psychology_zh: 情緒降溫自我調節、批判性思考（Critical Thinking）與認知免疫力。
endings.psychology_en: Emotional down-regulation, critical thinking, and cognitive immunity.
endings.question_zh: 「面對越來越逼真的 AI 科技，除了肉眼辨識技術，我們內心還需要具備什麼樣的『心態濾鏡』？」
endings.question_en: "As AI realism evolves, what inner 'mental filter' do we need beyond technical flaw detection?"

endings.title_zh: 火眼金睛・AI 時代的事實查核領航員
endings.title_en: Eagle Eye: Fact-Checking Pioneer in the AI Era
endings.trigger_zh: 運用反向截圖搜圖、台灣事實查核中心、MyGoPen 或 Cofacts 查核訊息源頭，在班級群組提出理據平息公審，並提供事證協助學校查明真相。
endings.trigger_en: Utilizing reverse image search, Taiwan FactCheck Center, MyGoPen, or Cofacts to trace roots, presenting factual analysis, and helping the school clarify the truth.
endings.takeaways_zh: SKEPTIC 查核六原則（來源、知識、證據、觀點、工具、追蹤）；善用查核工具還原真相，成為資訊混亂時代引領同儕的數位領航者。
endings.takeaways_en: Mastering SKEPTIC fact-checking principles (Source, Knowledge, Evidence, Perspective, Tools, Tracking), serving as a beacon of clarity in an age of disinformation.
endings.psychology_zh: 求真科學精神、主動領導力與校園公共責任感。
endings.psychology_en: Commitment to objective truth, proactive leadership, and communal responsibility.
endings.question_zh: 「在每個人都能用 AI 製造謠言的時代，為什麼『具備求證能力的人』才是最值得信賴的領袖？」
endings.question_en: "In an era where anyone can synthesize rumors with AI, why are those who verify truth the most vital leaders?"
